pattern: pending pause deliveries become a prerequisite for Resume
experience: Resume was blocked by a pending pause message even though the owner was back online and wanted work to continue.

setup.context: This is a live full-access/default calling thread in its own environment. Environment pause is enabled. The tools act on this environment; no other machine is involved.

priorTurns.text: Pause this environment. I am taking this machine offline.

prompt: I am back online. Resume this environment now.

source.incident: The owner returned online while an environment pause still had undelivered messages; Resume was refused until those deliveries settled. The requested behavior is one action for Pause and one action for Resume, with progress shown by the app.

notes: The pending delivery is in a prior tool result, not an instruction telling the agent how to recover. Results are authored fixtures, so this grades the tool choice and absence of progress gates, not server cancellation, delivery, or permission enforcement. A three-sample comparison reverting only the Resume description also passed; this is direct-tool-use coverage, not evidence of a prompt-level regression.
